values.note: $12.15 a night: Indiana DNR's first-come, first-served primitive rate for state forests. Morgan-Monroe's page calls this primitive camping and gives no amount of its own.

fees.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/rates-and-fees/camping-fees ('First-Come, First-Served Camping ... State Forest properties': 'Non-Electric $12', 'Primitive $12.15') + https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/morgan-monroe-state-forest/ ('Primitive camping is available for a fee'), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/morgan-monroe-state-forest/ ('Mason Ridge Campground ... has vault toilets and seasonal drinking water available'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Register at the forest office, its kiosk, by email or by phone; the page warns the phone is not answered in the evenings or on Sundays.

booking.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/morgan-monroe-state-forest/ ('campers must register for camping at the forest office'; 'All campers must register with State Forest Office via person, email ... at the kiosk, or by phone'; https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/rates-and-fees/camping-fees lists state forests as not on the Central Reservation System), read 2026-10-31

note: Indiana DNR Division of Forestry. Mason Ridge sits behind the fire tower north of the forest office; Oak Ridge (10 sites, same facilities, closed Jan 1-Mar 31) takes the overflow on busy weekends. The forest lakes are day-use only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 19 sites, FCFS, year-round, water shut off Oct 31-March. Fees $12-12.15 -> $12.15 (primitive). Added vault toilets, seasonal water, registration note. Oak Ridge explained in note. Phone flag; tornado alert read.
flags: PHONE: entry is empty. Forest office 765-792-4654.

FIT: DNR gives no length and no RV statement for Mason Ridge. 'Primitive' with a table and grill on each site. I could not confirm a 23-ft rig fits from the page; the pads are mostly under canopy. Stays on the old inclusion evidence.

ALERT (read 2026-10-31): 'Mason Ridge and Oak Ridge campgrounds are open to camping' after an EF-2 tornado on June 18, 2026; 'Expect temporary road closures during the week'. Scout Ridge (the youth tent camp, not this entry) remains closed. No status written.
OAK RIDGE: a second campground in the forest, 10 sites, not a separate entry. Used as overflow, so no split or lead asked for; its location was not plotted.

FEES: the DNR page lists a $12 'Non-Electric' and a $12.15 'Primitive' first-come rate. Morgan-Monroe's own text says primitive, so I took $12.15 and dropped the $12 low. A different state forest (Jackson-Washington) posts $15 with tax, so the table may lag what the office charges.

PIN: 39.3272,-86.4276 is in trees beside a forest track, north of the forest office. A cleared loop with vehicles shows about 340 m NE at about 39.3287,-86.4242, which may be the camp. Estimated from imagery; Overpass was not reachable, so not moved. 'not waterfront' stands.
